subject: Dress-rehearsal: Tri-party marketplace co-sell demo (AWS / GCP / Azure) — timing & fallbacks
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@helixsystems.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@cloudsi.co>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo — proposed rehearsal slot

Hi Soojin / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the demo invite. We need to request a small change: the original slot falls on a regional holiday for several of our APAC engineers. Can we move the dry-run earlier in the day (our side prefers 08:30–10:00 IST) or to the following day? Also a quick ask: can the run include a 15-minute network/latency check with our infra lead (I'll loop Suresh) before the recording?

I've attached our current agenda and the network topology snapshot — Suresh will verify ports.

Attachments: Helix-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, network-diagram.png

Best,
Amit Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, Helix Systems
amit.shah@helixsystems.com
+91 98X-XXX-XXXX
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@helixsystems.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@cloudsi.co>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo — proposed rehearsal slot

Thanks Amit — understood and totally fine to adjust. Quick notes and proposal:

- We can do a 08:30–10:15 IST window on Tue Aug 17 (that gives us 15 min buffer for the network check + a 90 min dry run).
- If that doesn't work for your APAC team, alternate: Wed Aug 18, 01:00–02:30 UTC (which maps well to late-morning APAC / early EMEA overlap).
- We will include a short recording test and the network/latency check first thing (10–15 min). Vivek will run the latency checklist.

Can folks confirm preference? I will block a tentative calendar and share an updated agenda + run order.

Action items from Redwood:
- Vanessa: finalize presenter order and handoff points between Redwood <> SI <> Helix (who demos what).
- Karthik: verify marketplace listing checklist that we want to demo (pricing UI + install flow).
- Vivek: prepare network test checklist and coordinates with Suresh.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Amit Shah <amit.shah@helixsystems.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@cloudsi.co>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo — proposed rehearsal slot

+1 for Tue Aug 17 08:30 IST. A couple of clarifications from the Redwood side:

- Presenter split: Redwood will cover 20 min intro (platform value + latency/cost bullets), Helix to demo the integration flow (25–30 min), SI (CloudSI) to do deployment + marketplace listing walkthrough (20 min). Final 15 min for Q&A + go-to-market notes.
- Olga — can you confirm you'll own the live failover demo (if the SI network path is blocked)? We want a scripted fallback so the audience sees graceful degradation.
- Karthik — confirm the marketplace checkout flow is in the attached checklist; we should not demo payment flows but show the listing + install steps.

I will tentatively accept the Tue slot and share calendar invites once we get final confirmation from Helix + CloudSI.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
From: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@cloudsi.co>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Amit Shah <amit.shah@helixsystems.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 23:02:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo — proposed rehearsal slot

Thanks — Tue Aug 17 08:30 IST works for our infra lead. Quick notes from SI ops:

- We'll need the AWS account IDs and a test listing stub (no live payment) to validate the install flow. Please share the sandbox access by EOD today so we can validate.
- For the network test: allowlist ports 443, 8443, and 50051 for TCP between Helix VPC and Redwood staging region-us-west-2.
- I've attached a checklist for the marketplace integration — please review and flag anything missing.

Attachments: marketplace-integration-checklist.xlsx

Suresh Patel
CloudSI — Lead Solutions Architect
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@helixsystems.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@cloudsi.co>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 01:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo — confirmed rehearsal + prep pack

All set — booking confirmed. Final logistics and links below: 

- Confirmed slot: Tue, 17 Aug 2027, 08:30–10:15 IST (UTC+5:30). Calendar invites sent.
- Pre-reqs: Helix to provide sandbox account IDs + temporary IAM (restrict to demo resources) by EOD today.
- Network test runbook: Vivek will lead a 12-min check at 08:30 IST. If the SI path shows >150ms median, we will switch to the recorded failover demo (Olga will run).
- Recording & playback: Redwood will record; Helix ok to share short clip with their sales team. If anyone objects to recording, flag now.

Attachments included in invite: Helix-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, network-diagram.png, marketplace-integration-checklist.xlsx

Quick checklist (who owns what):
- Helix (Amit): sandbox IDs, primary POC for product demo, confirm b-roll slides (2).
- CloudSI (Suresh): infra checklist, verify ports and latency.
- Redwood (Vanessa/Olga/Karthik/Vivek): run order, failover script, marketplace listing stub, and recording.

If any blocker comes up overnight, reply-all and we will pivot to Wed Aug 18 alternate slot.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth rehearsal.

Soojin Lee
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
